alan (docs): Quick catch from customer report: /tokenize reference shows `truncate: true` as a boolean in examples but the runtime expects an enum `truncate: "none" | "start" | "end"`. Opening a small PR to fix examples and add migration guidance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4307

hema (eng-runtime): Confirmed. We changed truncate from bool->enum to support different behaviors. Runtime will still accept `true/false` for now (maps to `end`/`none`) but we plan to remove boolean support in one minor. Docs should show canonical enum usage and note the temporary mapping: `true -> "end"`, `false -> "none"` so customers aren't surprised. Also mention that `truncate` applies before tokenization steps for some models.

jordan (sdk): Our SDKs currently pass whatever shape the user provides. I'll add a helper `normalizeTruncate(value)` in JS and Python that maps booleans to the enum and update client examples to call it. Suggest docs show both shapes with a clear migration snippet, and link to the SDK helper once merged. I'll open the SDK PR after docs land.

viv (docs-review): A couple of small nits: 1) canonical header casing for curl examples `Authorization`, 2) include Content-Type in example curl, 3) code fences should include language for syntax highlighting. Also recommend a tiny compatibility table in the reference: current runtime mapping, deprecation timeline, and suggested code snippet.

alan (docs): Will update curl/python/node snippets: show canonical enum examples like `{ "truncate": "end" }`, include migration section titled "Truncate boolean -> enum migration" that explains mapping and timeline. Also add a one-line QA test suggestion: POST with `truncate: true` and assert the tokenized output equals `truncate: "end"` behavior.

hema (eng-runtime): Add note: if both `truncate` and `max_tokens` are provided, truncation happens first. This matters for prompt-length checks; put that in the behavior section.

jordan (sdk): I pushed a tiny branch with the helper and example usage. Will open PR and link to docs once it's green. Example snippet for Node that docs can include:
```js
const payload = { text: prompt };
payload.truncate = normalizeTruncate(userInputTruncate);
await client.tokenize(payload);
```

ci-bot: docs-ci: running linter and markdown checks... (warning: one example missing language)

alan (docs): Fixed code-fence languages and pushed PR updates to 4307. Added migration table and behavior note about ordering with `max_tokens`. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4307

viv (docs-review): LGTM aside from one micro-nit: prefer showing enum values in the param table as code spans (e.g., "end", "start") for clarity. Can you update that?

alan (docs): Done. Updated param table and added the short QA test in PR description.

ci-bot: docs-ci \u2705 build passed. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4307--redwood-docs.netlify.app/reference/tokenize#parameters

alan (docs): Merging after CI green. Jordan, link your SDK PR in the migration note when ready and we'll add a short example to the quickstart. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
